item.title: Future-focused, Japan-based U.S. Air Force wings conduct first-ever iteration of Exercise BEVERLY MIDNIGHT 26 to enhance warfighting readiness
item.description: U.S. Air Force wings based in Japan are synchronized to participate in BEVERLY MIDNIGHT 2026 (BM26), Mar. 9 - 19, 2026. BM26 is a USAF-led proof-of-concept operational exercise designed to enhance the interoperability, command and control, and readiness of 5 AF headquarters and its wings (35 FW, 374 AW, 18 WG) within a contemporary scenario. The exercise is the first of its kind in Japan to focus on the 5 Air Expeditionary Task Force and USAF Japan-based wings as the primary training audience. T

item.title: U.S. Indo-Pacific Command Hosts Commander’s Conference 2026
item.description: HONOLULU– U.S. Indo-Pacific Command, brought together more than 50 senior joint-force leaders for a two-day Commander’s Conference at USINDOPACOM headquarters, Camp H.M. Smith, Hawaii, Feb. 25-26.

item.title: Precision Sustainment in the Arctic: 402nd AFSB’s LSE (D) Supports 11th Airborne During JPMRC Alaska
item.description: During Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center (JPMRC) Alaska, the 402nd Army Field Support Brigade’s Logistics Support Element (Division) and Army Field Support Battalion–Alaska delivered precision sustainment in one of the Army’s most demanding environments. By synchronizing directly with the 11th Airborne Division and leveraging Army Materiel Command enterprise capabilities, the team rapidly resolved complex maintenance and communications challenges, including vehicle electrical failures

item.title: Japan, U.S. forces conduct Fleet Synthetic Training Joint 26-71
item.description: Japan Self-Defense Forces and U.S. forces conducted Fleet Synthetic Training Joint (FST-J) 26-71 at Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka and command centers across the region Feb. 23-27, 2026.

item.title: Allied Forces integrate rapid HIMARS capability during Cobra Gold 2026
item.description: LOP BURI, Thailand — U.S. Army Soldiers executed a High Mobility Artillery Rocket System Rapid Infiltration training mission, demonstrating the joint force’s ability to rapidly deploy long-range precision fire into austere and contested environments during Exercise Cobra Gold 2026, March 1. The HIRAIN enables the High Mobility Artillery Rocket System to be transported by aircraft such as the C-130 or C-17 from a staging base to a forward location, where it can rapidly establish a firing position

item.title: USS SHOUP HOLDS CHANGE OF COMMAND CEREMONY IN YOKOSUKA
item.description: YOKOSUKA, Japan (Feb. 28, 2026) — The Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Shoup (DDG 86) held a change of command ceremony aboard the ship in Yokosuka, Japan, Feb. 28, marking the transition of leadership from Capt. Holman R. Agard to Capt. William S. Buford.

item.title: MSC Delivers Gear in Support of Cobra Gold 2026
item.description: The Military Sealift Command (MSC)-chartered steam ship Cape Island (T-AKR 10) arrived at the port of Chuk Samet, Sattahip, Thailand, Feb. 18–20, to offload equipment in support of Exercise Cobra Gold 2026.

item.title: U.S. and ROK Marines Train Together during Freedom Shield 26 and the Korean Marine Exercise Program 26.1
item.description: CAMP MUJUK, South Korea - III Marine Expeditionary Force (III MEF) Marines joins forces with the Republic of Korea (ROK) Marine Corps to conduct exercises Freedom Shield 26 and Korean Marine Exercise Program (KMEP) 26.1 throughout various training locations in South Korea from March 9 to March 19.

item.title: Lead, Develop, Care: Kunsan fosters leadership skills in Airmen
item.description: KUNSAN AIR BASE, Republic of Korea -- As service members advance in their careers, they may face varying leadership challenges and responsibilities, requiring military supervisors to not only delegate tasks but also develop their troops into future leaders. To further hone these skills, leaders at Kunsan Air Base attended a workshop presented by the Doolittle Leadership Center from Feb. 3-6, 2026.

item.title: Military Working Dogs Take to the Water in Unique Training Event
item.description: RAMSTEIN AIR BASE, Germany - More than 20 military working dogs from five kennels across Germany traded their usual training grounds for the pool deck during a first-of-its-kind water familiarization and enrichment event hosted by the Veterinary Medical Center Europe.
